svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut one piece 240 long x 90 deep from 18 mm plywood; sand the edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark a centre line across it, 120 mm from each end, on the top face and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: down the front edge: it lines up with the mat's centre mark.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The post stands on the centre line, 45 mm back from the front edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four pilot holes 3 mm, 12 mm deep, for the foot angle screws:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 39 mm each side of the centre line, 25 and 65 mm back from the front edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Better: drill them through the foot angles when fitting (step 2).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Paint the front edge the mat's grey so it disappears if it shows at all.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: back edge flush with the back edge of the bench, held by two

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: G-clamps 20 mm in from each end. The front edge is where the mat stops.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: flat, square corners, centre line marked on top and front.
